messages:
anya_partnerships: Quick heads-up  proposing a lightweight SI "satellite" onboarding pilot for APAC/EU micro-partners. Goal: 4-week ramp + short cert so partners can list on cloud marketplaces and support basic HW installs. Low-touch, repeatable. Thoughts? :globe_with_meridians:

devon_solutions: Love it. Cohort-based or rolling?

anya_partnerships: Cohort-based initially (every 6 wks) to batch trainer time and kit shipments. Signup form going live Mon.

kelly_ops: Logistics note  APAC customs ~10 days. Recommend digital-first: VM images + remote GPU seats; optional HW voucher for on-prem tests.

chris_sales: GTM: let's do a small joint announcement per cohort (partner spotlight + marketplace entry). Marketing needs quote + logo 3w ahead.

sam_lewis: Ops checklist for cohort 1:
- create private sandbox org + 12 dev seats
- upload AMIs / VM snapshots
- share terraform demo module in #devex
Will need participant emails to provision.

anya_partnerships: Also need a voucher flow + 30-min cert exam + badge asset.

kelly_ops: Voucher draft:
```
voucher: SAT-APAC-001
redeem: marketplace -> claim -> email ops@redwood.com
validity: 60 days
``` 
I can start procurement GH issue.

marketplace-bot: Listing checklist updated: catalog-image, quickstart, pricing-flag, partner-link. https://marketplace.redwood.internal/checklist

devon_solutions: Curriculum sketch: week0 orientation + marketplace onboarding; wk1 deployment & model pinning; wk2 observability & rollouts; wk3 troubleshooting + cert. Each week = 2h live + labs.

chris_sales: If listing approval lags, publish partner blog + demo clip and mark marketplace link "coming soon". Marketing okay.

anya_partnerships: Action items: Ill publish signup + calendar Mon; @devon_solutions finalize curriculum; @kelly_ops confirm lab & voucher; @sam_lewis provision sandbox once we have emails; @chris_sales coordinate marketing assets. Next sync after signup live. :rocket:
